blocks.html: This reference shows all the events emitted by the Medusa application related to the Promotion Module. If you use the module outside the Medusa application, these events aren't emitted.

events.name: campaign.created
campaign.updated
campaign.deleted
campaign.promotions_updated
events.description: Emitted when promotions are added to or removed from a campaign.
events.payload:
```ts
{
  id, // The ID of the campaign
  added_promotion_ids, // The IDs of the promotions added to the campaign
  removed_promotion_ids, // The IDs of the promotions removed from the campaign
}
```

events.name: promotion.created
promotion.updated
events.description: Emitted when promotions are updated, including their status.

events.name: promotion.deleted
promotion.rules_updated
events.description:
Emitted when a promotion's rules, target rules, or buy rules
are created, updated, or deleted in a batch.
events.payload:
```ts
{
  id, // The ID of the promotion
  rule_type, // The type of rules changed: "rules", "target_rules", or "buy_rules"
  created, // The IDs of the created rules
  updated, // The IDs of the updated rules
  deleted, // The IDs of the deleted rules
}
```
